title: BADBOX 3.0 active again: about 40 billion fake ad requests per day from infected AOSP Android devices
content_md:
BADBOX 3.0 is active again: it infects AOSP-based Android devices and generates about 40 billion fake advertising requests per day, the largest documented volume so far.

via Mastodon https://linuxmint.hu/hir/2026/11/a-badbox-botnet-visszatert-napi-40-milliard-hamis-hirdetesi-ajanlatkerest-general
